name: oneshot-tv
description: Flick developer scripts. Run from the repository root.

scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter oneshot-ui test && pnpm --filter oneshot-ui typecheck
scripts.bindings: cargo test -p oneshot-core -p oneshot-playback -p oneshot-player -p oneshot-catalog --features "oneshot-core/ts oneshot-playback/ts oneshot-player/ts oneshot-catalog/ts" export_bindings
